title: Ice Cream at Home
description: At the park on a beautiful fall day, Grandma asks the kids if they want to go out for ice cream. Kid-3 reminds her that they have ice cream at home.
alt: On a sunny fall afternoon at a playground with swings, a slide, and colorful autumn leaves, Grandma asks if the kids want to go out for ice cream. Kid-3, holding her stuffed bunny, replies, “But Grandma, we have ice cream at home!” Pa and kid-1 and kid-2 listen silently.
